verdict_reason: Full-contour comparison. The dominant SECOND-mode cutoff branch agrees with Özgen to 2% (the transition-relevant high-Mach instability boundary). HOWEVER pyMack predicts a CONNECTED first-second-mode unstable band where Özgen's panel (f) shows two lobes separated by a stable gap, so the inner gap-edge branches (2nd-mode onset 59%, 1st-mode cutoff 94%) and the 1st-mode onset (20%) do not match. This is a documented topology / inter-mode over-prediction at high Mach (the marginal first-mode weak spot), not a 2nd-mode-curve error. topology_ok = false.
